# Beacon by Monolith

> Emergency lighting test software for UK contractors. Test on site (even offline), keep a living site register, and issue BS 5266 paperwork from the visit — free in open beta.

Monolith Compliance builds Beacon: Field (phone/tablet, offline-capable) for on-site monthly and annual emergency lighting tests, and Console (desktop) for sites, team, history, and certificates.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/): Product overview, demo walkthrough, sample paperwork, FAQ
- [Templates](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/resources/): Free blank Beacon certificate and visit report PDFs
- [Periodic Inspection Report template](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/resources/emergency-lighting-periodic-inspection-report-template.html): Blank visit report PDF
- [Periodic certificate template](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/resources/emergency-lighting-certificate-template.html): Blank site certificate PDF
- [Guides](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/): Practical BS 5266 guides for UK contractors
- [How often to test](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/how-often-to-test-emergency-lighting.html): Monthly function vs annual duration
- [Monthly flick test](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/how-to-do-monthly-emergency-lighting-test.html): Step-by-step monthly function test
- [Annual duration test](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/how-to-run-annual-emergency-lighting-duration-test.html): How to run the three-hour annual
- [Visit report vs certificate vs logbook](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/visit-report-vs-certificate-vs-logbook.html): Which paperwork after a test
- [Logbook: what to record](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/emergency-lighting-logbook-uk.html): What each logbook entry needs
- [Living site register](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/living-site-register.html): Stop rewriting the fitting list every visit
- [Test software (UK)](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/guides/emergency-lighting-testing-software-uk.html): Compare Beacon, FireCert, cert apps, and scheduling tools
- [Privacy](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/privacy.html): Privacy policy (Monolith Compliance)
- [Terms](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/terms.html): Terms of service
- [Beacon app](https://beacon.monolithcompliance.co.uk/): Sign in / open beta product

## Product facts

- Audience: UK contractors, competent persons, multi-site managers doing BS 5266 emergency lighting work
- Field: on-site testing, defects, history; works with no signal; add to home screen (no App Store)
- Console: sites, team, audit history, organisation branding on PDFs
- Paperwork: fitting test report, visit periodic inspection report, site periodic inspection and testing certificate
- Templates: blank versions of the visit report and site certificate are free to download for manual completion
- Import: bring fittings from an existing spreadsheet/logbook
- Pricing: free in open beta; pricing announced before any charges
- Not certified or endorsed by BSI; duty-holder remains responsible for fire-safety compliance
- Contact: feedback@monolithcompliance.co.uk
